title: Lower Buckler (Piglin Proliferation)
description: Lowers the buckler from Piglin Proliferation in first person view.
body:
Requires the Piglin Proliferation mod, found here: https://modrinth.com/mod/piglin-proliferation

A "Low Shield" resource pack for the buckler item from Piglin Proliferation (Lowers the buckler in first person view).
